stem.text: The graph shows the results of an osmosis investigation using potato tissue.

stem.alt: Graph of percentage change in mass against concentration of sodium chloride in mol dm^-3, from 0 to 0.9, with the percentage change axis from -20 to 20. Eleven plotted points are joined by line segments.

stem.text: What is the concentration of sodium chloride solution that has the equivalent water potential to this potato tissue and what is correct about the movement of water at that point?

A.text: $0.37\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ and no net movement of water

B.text: $17\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ and net movement of water out of the potato tissue

C.text: $0\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ and no net movement of water

D.text: $0.9\,\text{mol dm}^{-3}$ and net movement of water into the potato tissue
